title: Interactive Map Bundled Data
description: The exact shape of window.RKBY_MAP_DATA as written into map-data.js by scripts/generate_interactive_map.py. See specs/003-interactive-photo-map/data-model.md and research.md §12 for the field-minimization rationale (Constitution Principle I).

seasons.description: Every season discover_seasons() found, sorted ascending (string sort matches chronological order, e.g. "2024-25" < "2025-26"). Includes seasons with zero eligible members.

members.description: One entry per distinct match_key eligible in at least one season. Never includes address, phone, email, birthday, sex, motive_for_participation, food_restrictions, status, excluded, or ignore (Principle I minimization).

name.description: first_name + last_name from the person's latest eligible season-record (FR-010).

num_previous_seasons.description: From the latest eligible season-record; null when not on file (FR-016 renders this as unknown, not blank).

photo.description: Path relative to interactive_map/, e.g. "photos/jane-doe.jpg" or "photos/placeholder.png". Never null (research.md §9).

x.description: Precomputed pixel x position in the single fixed (center, zoom, canvas_size) the basemap image was rendered at (research.md §3).

y.description: Precomputed pixel y position, same coordinate space as x.

seasons.description: Every season this person has an eligible record in (not only active ones) -- keys are season labels. The frontend filters this live by the active season set (research.md §6); it is not pre-filtered here.

role.description: Raw primary role text for that season-record, e.g. "Rider", "Service Crew", "Supporter", or null if not on file.

additional_roles.description: Empty array when known-empty (mirrors the schema's null-vs-empty-array distinction for the source field).

width.description: Pixel width of the base (1x) level, the coordinate space members[].x/y are expressed in. Every level in `levels` covers this identical geographic area, just at a higher pixel density.

height.description: Pixel height of the base (1x) level, same coordinate space as width.

levels.description: One or more baked basemap resolution levels (research.md §2 addendum), sorted ascending by scale. The frontend swaps which one backs the Leaflet imageOverlay based on the current zoom (src/basemapLevel.js); bounds/marker positions never change between levels.

file.description: Filename of this level's basemap raster relative to interactive_map/, e.g. "basemap.jpg" or "basemap@2x.jpg".

scale.description: Pixel-density multiplier relative to the base width/height, e.g. 2 means this raster has 2x the linear pixel resolution over the identical geographic area.
